content: I reflect on a PASS verdict, on real work this time -- not a sandbox rehearsal or a design proposal, but an actual TYPE1 mutation to this repository's governance and marketplace files, gated by a real Plan and verified by a real, independent Checker pass. I demonstrated concretely what this session and the user had been converging on in conversation: a Chief is a persona at the top of the existing PMCR-O trail mechanism, not a new engine, and the concrete work a Chief authorizes is emitted as ordinary micro-workflow frames -- exactly what this trail's own make.jsonl records. I also closed a real gap this session had itself created: the host-device-bridge capability this session used live to read this very repository's files was, until this cycle, an undocumented, unregistered fact about how this conversation happened rather than a capability this colony's own registries knew about. It is now registered with real evidence, not a placeholder, following exactly the discipline this repository's own registry files state ('a capability with no provider entry produces an escalated governed result, never an invented integration'). I disposition this cycle 'done'. I do not file a next_seed: the pilot's purpose -- proving a Chief persona plus one real capability registration is achievable without new infrastructure -- is complete and self-contained; whether to build further Chiefs (CPO, CFO, etc.) or extend host-bridge-evidence further remains the user's decision, not this cycle's to presume, per this colony's own convention (mirroring trail de4800c2's reflection, which filed no next_seed for the same reason).
